title: Irrigation Zone Runtime and Rain-Skip
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume / Flo / HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irrigation:zone
| stats sum(runtime_min) as minutes, sum(eval(if(skipped="rain",1,0))) as rain_skips, count as cycles by zone
| sort - minutes
description: Summarises how long each irrigation zone ran and how often it sensibly skipped watering after rain.
value: Seeing runtime and rain-skips per zone confirms the controller is watering smartly rather than soaking the garden after a downpour.
implementation: Ingest irrigation controller events; schedule weekly and review runtime and rain-skips by zone.
visualization: Bar chart of watering minutes by zone with rain-skip counts.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how long each part of the garden was watered and when it wisely skipped because of rain.
